label: STEP 1
head: Rate 5 areas out of 10
sub: Body, mind, relationships, money, work. Write the numbers down.

label: STEP 2
head: Pick the 2 with the biggest payoff
sub: Not always your lowest. Write what holds each one back.

label: STEP 3
head: One goal per area, done by Dec 31
sub: You must be able to say yes or no. "Lift 3x a week", not "get fit".

label: STEP 4
head: Write what will get in your way
sub: Holiday parties, travel, late nights. Decide your move now.

pre: January 1st you either start from zero
text: or you start with *33 days of proof.*

head: Grab a pen *tonight*
sub: One sheet of paper. Ten minutes.
